description: Dependency-update policy for docker-autoheal. Renovate creates and maintains dependency PRs. Patch updates are automerged once required checks pass; all other updates require manual review and merge. See docs/maintainer/dependency-management.md for the full explanation.

customManagers.description: Track the Python version that SonarCloud analyses against (sonar.python.version in .sonarcloud.properties), using the renovate: comment on the line above it.
Track the Python version Pyright checks against (pythonVersion in pyrightconfig.json), so it moves with the other Python runtime pins.

Track the Python version Ruff targets (target-version in .linter-rules/.ruff.toml, written as py314), so it moves with the other Python runtime pins. The py prefix and the dot are rebuilt around the version Renovate reads and writes.

packageRules.description: Update the Python version everywhere in one PR: the Dockerfile image, the Dev Container image, sonar.python.version, pythonVersion in pyrightconfig.json and target-version in .linter-rules/.ruff.toml. minimumGroupSize must equal the number of pins, so the PR is only created once all of them have an update (the Dev Container image can lag a new Python release). The contract test in app/tests/unit/test_dev_stack_files.py checks that they agree. Only major and minor updates are grouped, so routine digest refreshes of the existing tags are not held back by the minimum. Python releases are minor or major updates, so automerge stays disabled.

Update the Node major everywhere in one PR: the Dockerfile image, node-version in tests.yml and production-smoke-test.yml, and the node feature's version option in devcontainer.json (read by Renovate's built-in devcontainer manager). minimumGroupSize must equal the number of pins, so the PR is only created once all of them have an update. The contract test in app/tests/unit/test_dev_stack_files.py checks that they agree. Only major updates are grouped, so digest refreshes are not held back by the minimum. Node majors need a manual merge. The rule matches the dependency name rather than the package name, because the setup-node pins in the workflows have the package name actions/node-versions while the Dockerfile and Dev Container pins are named node.
Keep automerge disabled by default for all dependency updates. A later, narrower rule enables it only for eligible patch updates. See docs/maintainer/dependency-management.md.
Group Prettier dependency updates across package files into one PR.

Coordinate major upgrades of the interdependent frontend build and test toolchain in one PR, so lockfile generation sees compatible Vite, Vitest and plugin majors together. Patch and minor updates keep their normal grouping.

Automerge patch updates once all required CI checks pass, including 0.x dependencies. Minor and major updates keep automerge disabled. Relies on GitHub required status checks; see docs/maintainer/dependency-management.md.
Pin Docker image tags to an immutable SHA256 digest as well as their human-readable tag/version where the registry supports digests.

sonar.python.version in .sonarcloud.properties, pythonVersion in pyrightconfig.json and target-version in .linter-rules/.ruff.toml are values that their tools parse, so they must never get a digest appended. Keep this after the general digest pinning rule.

Dev Container features and the Dev Container base image are tracked by tag, not by digest, because local tooling floats within its tag. ghcr.io and mcr.microsoft.com give Renovate no release timestamps, so with internalChecksFilter strict their updates would wait in Pending Status Checks forever; timestamp-optional lets them through. This is scoped to the Dev Container files so production images keep the full minimumReleaseAge. Keep this after the general digest pinning rule.
tommye123/docker-autoheal is this project's own published image, not a third-party dependency. Renovate should not manage it.
